jp-20261107-news-3.title: Furusato Nozei: Key Points on System Revisions, Deduction Limits, and Tips for Choosing Return Gifts Before the Year-End Rush

segments.src: ## はじめに:寄付が集中する年末こそ「確認」が大切
segments.tr: ## Introduction: Why "Checking" is Essential During the Year-End Donation Rush

segments.src: ふるさと納税は、応援したい自治体に寄付をすると、自己負担2,000円を除いた金額が所得税・住民税から差し引かれる制度です。寄付の申し込みは年末に集中しやすく、12月は各ポータルサイトの申し込みが混み合う時期でもあります。
segments.tr: Furusato Nozei (Hometown Tax Donation) is a system where, if you donate to a municipality you wish to support, the amount minus a 2,000 yen self-burden is deducted from your income tax and resident tax. Donation applications tend to concentrate at the end of the year, and December is a busy time for all portal sites.

segments.src: 一方で、制度は近年たびたび見直されており、「去年と同じ感覚」で選ぶと思わぬ落とし穴にはまることがあります。この記事では、制度見直しの要点、控除上限額の目安、手続きで失敗しないためのポイントを整理します。なお、制度の詳細や運用は変更される場合があるため、最終的には総務省の案内や各自治体、お住まいの市区町村、税務署などの公式情報で確認してください。
segments.tr: On the other hand, the system has been frequently revised in recent years, and choosing based on "the same feeling as last year" can lead to unexpected pitfalls. This article organizes the key points of system revisions, estimates for deduction limits, and tips to avoid mistakes in the procedure. Please note that the details and operation of the system may change, so ultimately, please check official information from the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications, each municipality, your local city/ward/town/village office, or the tax office.

segments.src: ## 1. 近年の制度見直しの要点
segments.tr: ## 1. Key Points of Recent System Revisions

segments.src: ### 返礼品のルールが厳格化されている
segments.tr: ### Stricter Rules for Return Gifts

segments.src: 返礼品は「寄付額の3割以下」「地場産品であること」という基準が設けられています。近年は、この「地場産品」の基準が運用面でより厳格になり、原材料の産地や、自治体内でどの工程を行っているかが問われる場面が増えています。
segments.tr: Return gifts are subject to criteria such as "30% or less of the donation amount" and "must be a local product." In recent years, the criteria for "local products" have become stricter in practice, and there are increasing cases where the origin of raw materials and which processes are performed within the municipality are questioned.

segments.src: - 熟成肉・精米などは、同じ都道府県内で生産された原材料を使うことが求められる方向で整理されています。
segments.tr: - For aged meat, polished rice, etc., it is required that raw materials produced within the same prefecture be used.

segments.src: - 以前は掲載されていた返礼品が、基準を満たさないとして取り下げられたり、内容が変更されたりすることがあります。
segments.tr: - Return gifts that were previously listed may be withdrawn or have their contents changed because they do not meet the criteria.

segments.src: ### 寄付に関わる費用の考え方が整理されている
segments.tr: ### Organizing the Concept of Costs Related to Donations

segments.src: 自治体が寄付の募集に使う費用は「寄付額の5割以下」とされています。近年は、ポータルサイトへの手数料や、発送・事務に要する費用なども含めて考える方向で整理が進みました。自治体にとっては、返礼品の内容や量を見直す動機になっています。
segments.tr: The costs that municipalities use to solicit donations are set at "50% or less of the donation amount." In recent years, the direction has been to include fees for portal sites, as well as shipping and administrative costs, in this calculation. For municipalities, this has become a motivation to review the content and quantity of return gifts.

segments.src: ### ポータルサイトのポイント付与をめぐる見直し
segments.tr: ### Revisions Regarding Point Grants on Portal Sites

segments.src: 寄付者に対し、ポータルサイトが独自のポイントを付与して利用を促す手法については、過熱を抑える観点から、制度上の取り扱いが見直されました。これにより、「どのサイトから申し込むか」で実質的にお得になる度合いが以前と変わっている場合があります。申し込み前に、現在のサイトの条件やキャンペーンの扱いを必ず確認しましょう。
segments.tr: Regarding the method where portal sites grant their own points to donors to encourage use, the treatment under the system has been revised from the perspective of curbing overheating. As a result, the degree of actual benefit depending on "which site you apply from" may differ from before. Before applying, be sure to check the current site conditions and campaign handling.

segments.src: > 実施時期や詳細な条件は、制度や各サイトの規約で異なる場合があります。必ず最新の公式情報を確認してください。
segments.tr: > Implementation timing and detailed conditions may differ depending on the system and the terms of each site. Always check the latest official information.

segments.src: ## 2. 自治体間の競争の実情
segments.tr: ## 2. The Reality of Competition Among Municipalities

segments.src: ふるさと納税は、寄付額の増加とともに、自治体間の競争が激しくなってきました。
segments.tr: With the increase in donation amounts, competition among municipalities for Furusato Nozei has intensified.

segments.src: - **返礼品の魅力を競う動き**:地域の特産品だけでなく、体験型や、地域の事業者と連携した商品など、工夫を凝らした返礼品が増えています。
segments.tr: - **Movements to compete on the appeal of return gifts**: In addition to local specialties, there is an increase in return gifts that are ingenious, such as experience-based gifts and products developed in collaboration with local businesses.

segments.src: - **寄付の使い道を示す動き**:返礼品ではなく、災害支援や子育て、地域の文化・自然の保全など、寄付金の使い道に共感して寄付を募る事例も広がっています。
segments.tr: - **Movements to show how donations are used**: Instead of return gifts, cases of soliciting donations by sympathizing with the use of donations, such as disaster support, child-rearing, and preservation of local culture and nature, are also spreading.

segments.src: - **住民税の流出という課題**:都市部の自治体では、住民が他の自治体へ寄付することで住民税が減る影響が生じており、財政への影響を懸念する声があります。
segments.tr: - **The issue of resident tax outflow**: In urban municipalities, there is an impact where resident tax decreases because residents donate to other municipalities, and there are concerns about the impact on finances.

segments.src: 寄付をする側としては、返礼品の見た目や量だけでなく、「寄付金が何に使われるのか」にも目を向けると、制度の本来の趣旨に沿った選び方ができます。
segments.tr: As a donor, if you look not only at the appearance and quantity of return gifts but also at "what the donation money will be used for," you can choose in line with the original purpose of the system.

segments.src: ## 3. 控除上限額の目安をつかむ
segments.tr: ## 3. Grasping the Estimate of the Deduction Limit

segments.src: ふるさと納税で「自己負担2,000円」で済むのは、年間の控除上限額の範囲内で寄付した場合です。上限を超えた分は自己負担になります。
segments.tr: In Furusato Nozei, you can settle with a "2,000 yen self-burden" if you donate within the annual deduction limit. The amount exceeding the limit will be your own burden.

segments.src: ### 上限額は人によって異なる
segments.tr: ### The Limit Varies by Person

segments.src: 控除上限額は、主に次の要素で決まります。
segments.tr: The deduction limit is mainly determined by the following factors:

segments.src: - 給与収入や事業所得などの年間所得
segments.tr: - Annual income such as salary income and business income

segments.src: - 家族構成(配偶者や扶養親族の有無など)
segments.tr: - Family structure (presence of spouse, dependents, etc.)

segments.src: - 住宅ローン控除、医療費控除、iDeCo(個人型確定拠出年金)の掛金など、ほかの控除の利用状況
segments.tr: - Usage status of other deductions such as housing loan deduction, medical expense deduction, and iDeCo (individual-type defined contribution pension) contributions

segments.src: ### 給与収入ごとの目安(参考)
segments.tr: ### Estimates by Salary Income (Reference)

segments.src: 以下は、給与所得者で、独身または共働き(配偶者控除の対象外)の場合の、年間上限額のごく大まかな目安です。
segments.tr: The following is a very rough estimate of the annual limit for salary earners who are single or dual-income (not subject to spousal deduction).

segments.src: | 給与収入 | 控除上限額の目安 |
segments.tr: | Salary Income | Estimated Deduction Limit |
| 3 million yen | Approx. 28,000 yen |
| 4 million yen | Approx. 42,000 yen |
| 5 million yen | Approx. 61,000 yen |
| 6 million yen | Approx. 77,000 yen |
| 7 million yen | Approx. 108,000 yen |
| 8 million yen | Approx. 129,000 yen |
| 10 million yen | Approx. 176,000 yen |

segments.src: あくまで目安です。実際の上限額は、昨年の源泉徴収票や、今年の見込み収入をもとに、各ポータルサイトのシミュレーターや総務省の資料などで確認しましょう。
segments.tr: These are just estimates. For the actual limit, check using the simulator on each portal site or materials from the Ministry of Internal Affairs and Communications based on last year's withholding tax slip and this year's expected income.

segments.src: ### 会社員の注意点
segments.tr: ### Points for Company Employees

segments.src: - 年の途中で転職・昇給・賞与の増減があると、年収が想定と変わります。直近の給与明細や見込みで試算し、**上限ぎりぎりまで寄付するのではなく、余裕を持たせる**と安心です。
segments.tr: - If you change jobs, get a raise, or have fluctuations in bonuses during the year, your annual income will differ from what you expected. It is safer to calculate based on your latest pay slip and projections, and **not donate right up to the limit, but leave some margin**.

segments.src: - 住宅ローン控除や医療費控除を受ける場合は、上限額が変わることがあります。
segments.tr: - If you receive a housing loan deduction or medical expense deduction, the limit may change.

segments.src: ### 個人事業主・フリーランスの注意点
segments.tr: ### Points for Sole Proprietors and Freelancers

segments.src: - 上限額は、収入ではなく所得(売上から必要経費などを引いた金額)をもとに計算されます。売上が多くても、所得が小さければ上限額は低くなります。
segments.tr: - The limit is calculated based on income (amount after deducting necessary expenses, etc. from sales), not sales. Even if sales are high, if income is low, the limit will be low.

segments.src: - 年内の所得が確定しにくいため、年末近くの試算が重要です。見込みが不確かな場合は、慎重に、少なめに見積もることをおすすめします。
segments.tr: - Since it is difficult to determine income within the year, calculations near the end of the year are important. If your projections are uncertain, it is recommended to be cautious and estimate on the lower side.

segments.src: - 青色申告特別控除、国民健康保険料や小規模企業共済の掛金などによる所得控除も影響します。
segments.tr: - Income deductions such as the blue return special deduction, national health insurance premiums, and small enterprise mutual relief contributions also have an effect.

segments.src: - 事業主は確定申告が必須なので、ワンストップ特例は使えません。寄付金控除は確定申告で申告します。
segments.tr: - Since business owners are required to file a tax return, the One-Stop Exception cannot be used. The donation deduction is declared in the tax return.

segments.src: ## 4. 手続きで失敗しないためのポイント
segments.tr: ## 4. Points to Avoid Mistakes in Procedures

segments.src: ### 申し込みの「期限」に注意
segments.tr: ### Pay Attention to the "Deadline" for Applications

segments.src: 寄付の年は、**12月31日までに決済が完了したもの**が対象になる扱いが一般的です。ただし、決済方法によって扱いが異なる場合があります。
segments.tr: The year of donation is generally treated as the year in which **payment is completed by December 31st**. However, handling may differ depending on the payment method.

segments.src: - クレジットカード:決済手続きが12月31日までに完了していること。
segments.tr: - Credit card: Payment procedures must be completed by December 31st.

segments.src: - 銀行振込・コンビニ払い:入金や払い込みの確認が年内になされていること。年末は金融機関の営業日にも注意が必要です。
segments.tr: - Bank transfer/Convenience store payment: Confirmation of deposit or payment must be made within the year. You also need to be careful about the business days of financial institutions at the end of the year.

segments.src: 「年内に申し込んだつもり」でも、年を越して決済されると翌年分になる可能性があります。**余裕を持って、12月中旬までに済ませる**のが安全です。
segments.tr: Even if you "intended to apply within the year," if payment is made after the year has passed, it may be treated as the following year's donation. It is safe to **complete it by mid-December with time to spare**.

segments.src: ### ワンストップ特例か、確定申告か
segments.tr: ### One-Stop Exception or Tax Return?

segments.src: | 項目 | ワンストップ特例制度 | 確定申告 |
segments.tr: | Item | One-Stop Exception System | Tax Return |

segments.src: | 対象 | 確定申告が不要な給与所得者など | 事業主、医療費控除などで申告する人 |
segments.tr: | Target | Salary earners who do not need to file a tax return, etc. | Business owners, people filing for medical expense deductions, etc. |

segments.src: | 寄付先の数 | 1年間で5自治体まで | 制限なし |
segments.tr: | Number of donation destinations | Up to 5 municipalities per year | No limit |

segments.src: | 手続き | 申請書を自治体に提出 | 寄付金受領証明書を添えて申告 |
segments.tr: | Procedure | Submit application form to the municipality | File with the donation receipt attached |

segments.src: | 控除の形 | 翌年度の住民税から控除 | 所得税の還付と住民税の控除 |
segments.tr: | Form of deduction | Deduction from the following year's resident tax | Income tax refund and resident tax deduction |

segments.src: ワンストップ特例の申請書の提出期限は、**翌年1月10日必着**が一般的です。期限を過ぎると適用されず、確定申告が必要になります。
segments.tr: The deadline for submitting the One-Stop Exception application form is generally **must arrive by January 10th of the following year**. If you miss the deadline, it will not be applied, and a tax return will be required.

segments.src: 特に注意したいのが次のケースです。
segments.tr: Be especially careful in the following cases:

segments.src: - **6自治体以上に寄付した**場合は、ワンストップ特例は使えず、確定申告が必要になります。
segments.tr: - If you **donated to 6 or more municipalities**, you cannot use the One-Stop Exception and must file a tax return.

segments.src: - 寄付後に**確定申告をした**場合、ワンストップ特例の申請は無効になります。医療費控除などで確定申告をする人は、寄付金控除も含めて申告します。
segments.tr: - If you **file a tax return** after donating, the One-Stop Exception application becomes invalid. People who file a tax return for medical expense deductions, etc., must also include the donation deduction in their tax return.

segments.src: - 申請書の**住所・氏名・マイナンバー関連書類**に不備があると、受け付けられないことがあります。
segments.tr: - If there are deficiencies in the **address, name, or My Number related documents** on the application form, it may not be accepted.

segments.src: ### 書類の管理
segments.tr: ### Document Management

segments.src: - 寄付金受領証明書や、ワンストップ特例の控えは、手元に保管しておきましょう。
segments.tr: - Keep the donation receipt and the copy of the One-Stop Exception application on hand.

segments.src: - 引っ越しや結婚などで住所・氏名が変わった場合は、変更の届け出が必要になることがあります。
segments.tr: - If your address or name changes due to moving or marriage, you may need to submit a change notification.

segments.src: ## 5. 返礼品選びの注意点
segments.tr: ## 5. Points to Note When Choosing Return Gifts

segments.src: ### 「お得さ」だけで選ばない
segments.tr: ### Don't Choose Just by "Value"

segments.src: - **配送時期**:果物や海産物などは、旬の時期に届くよう発送日が指定されています。年末の申し込みでは、発送が翌年になる商品も少なくありません。
segments.tr: - **Delivery timing**: For fruits and seafood, the shipping date is specified so that they arrive during the season. In year-end applications, there are many products where shipping will be in the following year.

segments.src: - **数量・保管場所**:大容量の冷凍品などは、冷凍庫の空きが十分かを確認しましょう。
segments.tr: - **Quantity/Storage space**: For large-capacity frozen items, check if there is enough space in the freezer.

segments.src: - **賞味期限・消費期限**:届いてから期限が短い食品もあります。
segments.tr: - **Expiration date/Best-before date**: Some foods have a short period after arrival.

segments.src: - **アレルギー表示**:食品は、原材料の表示を確認してください。
segments.tr: - **Allergy labeling**: For food, check the labeling of raw materials.

segments.src: ### 寄付の「寄付額」と「内容量」を見比べる
segments.tr: ### Compare "Donation Amount" and "Content Quantity"

segments.src: 同じような商品でも、自治体によって内容量が異なります。ただし、返礼割合の高さだけを追うのではなく、品質や、自分が本当に必要とするものかどうかも総合的に判断しましょう。
segments.tr: Even for similar products, the content quantity differs depending on the municipality. However, do not just chase the high return ratio, but judge comprehensively based on quality and whether it is something you really need.

segments.src: ### 掲載内容の変更に注意
segments.tr: ### Be Careful of Changes in Listed Content

segments.src: ルールの見直しにより、返礼品の内容や寄付金額が変更されることがあります。気に入った商品は、**申し込み画面で最新の内容を確認**してから手続きを進めましょう。
segments.tr: Due to rule revisions, the content of return gifts and donation amounts may change. For products you like, **check the latest content on the application screen** before proceeding with the procedure.

segments.src: ### 偽サイトや不審な勧誘に注意
segments.tr: ### Beware of Fake Sites and Suspicious Solicitations

segments.src: ふるさと納税を装った不審なメールやサイトによる被害も報告されています。
segments.tr: Damage caused by suspicious emails and sites posing as Furusato Nozei has also been reported.

segments.src: - 公式のポータルサイトや、自治体の公式ページから申し込みましょう。
segments.tr: - Apply from official portal sites or the official pages of municipalities.

segments.src: - クレジットカード情報や、マイナンバーを、メールやSNSのメッセージで求められても応じないようにしましょう。
segments.tr: - Do not respond even if you are asked for credit card information or My Number via email or SNS messages.

segments.src: ## 6. 年末までのチェックリスト
segments.tr: ## 6. Checklist Until the End of the Year

segments.src: 1. 今年の収入(事業主は所得)の見込みを確認し、控除上限額を試算した。
segments.tr: 1. Confirmed the expected income (income for business owners) for this year and calculated the deduction limit.

segments.src: 2. 試算に余裕を持たせ、上限を超えない範囲に収めた。
segments.tr: 2. Left a margin in the calculation and kept it within the range that does not exceed the limit.

segments.src: 3. 配送時期や保管場所、賞味期限を確認して返礼品を選んだ。
segments.tr: 3. Chose return gifts by checking the delivery timing, storage space, and expiration date.

segments.src: 4. 12月31日までに決済が完了するよう、余裕を持って申し込んだ。
segments.tr: 4. Applied with plenty of time so that payment is completed by December 31st.

segments.src: 5. 手続き方法(ワンストップ特例か確定申告か)を決めた。
segments.tr: 5. Decided on the procedure method (One-Stop Exception or Tax Return).

segments.src: 6. ワンストップ特例の場合、1月10日必着で申請書を提出できる準備をした。
segments.tr: 6. In the case of the One-Stop Exception, prepared to submit the application form so that it arrives by January 10th.

segments.src: 7. 受領証明書や申請書の控えを保管した。
segments.tr: 7. Kept the receipt and the copy of the application form.

segments.src: ## おわりに
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: ふるさと納税は、地域を応援しながら税負担を調整できる仕組みですが、制度の見直しや手続きの細かな条件を知らないと、思わぬ自己負担が生じることがあります。年末の駆け込みで慌てないよう、**上限額の試算、期限、手続き方法**の3点を早めに確認しておきましょう。
segments.tr: Furusato Nozei is a mechanism that allows you to adjust your tax burden while supporting regions, but if you do not know the system revisions and detailed conditions of the procedures, unexpected self-burden may occur. To avoid rushing at the end of the year, check the three points of **limit calculation, deadlines, and procedure methods** early.

segments.src: > 本記事は一般的な情報提供を目的としており、個別の税務判断を行うものではありません。ご自身の状況に応じた具体的な内容は、お住まいの自治体、税務署、税理士などの専門家にご確認ください。
segments.tr: > This article is for general information purposes and does not provide individual tax judgments. Please check specific details according to your own situation with your local municipality, tax office, tax accountant, or other experts.

jp-20261107-news-2.title: Labor Shortage Bankruptcies Remain at High Levels: Background and Industry-Specific Risks of Increasing Companies That Cannot Continue Even While Profitable

segments.src: ## はじめに:売上があっても事業を続けられない時代
segments.tr: ## Introduction: An Era Where Businesses Cannot Continue Even with Sales

segments.src: 人手が確保できないことを主因に事業を終える「人手不足倒産」が、近年高い水準で推移しています。民間の信用調査会社（帝国データバンク、東京商工リサーチなど）の集計でも、人手不足に関連する倒産件数は過去と比べて高い水準にあると報告されています。
segments.tr: "Labor shortage bankruptcies," where businesses terminate operations primarily due to an inability to secure human resources, have remained at high levels in recent years. Aggregations by private credit research companies (such as Teikoku Databank and Tokyo Shoko Research) also report that labor shortage-related bankruptcy cases are at high levels compared to the past.

segments.src: 特徴的なのは、**赤字ではなく、受注や顧客がありながら事業を維持できなくなるケース**が目立つ点です。この記事では、その背景と業種ごとの事情、地域経済や雇用への影響を整理します。
segments.tr: What is distinctive is that **cases where businesses cannot maintain operations despite not being in the red and having orders and customers** stand out. This article organizes the background, circumstances by industry, and impacts on the regional economy and employment.

segments.src: > ※本記事は公開されている調査機関・官公庁の発表傾向をもとにした一般的な解説です。具体的な件数や最新値は、各機関の最新の公表資料でご確認ください。
segments.tr: > *This article is a general commentary based on publication trends from public research institutions and government offices. Please check the latest official materials from each institution for specific numbers and the latest values.*

segments.src: ## 「人手不足倒産」とは何か
segments.tr: ## What is a "Labor Shortage Bankruptcy"?

segments.src: 人手不足倒産とは、従業員の退職や採用難、後継者の不在などにより、事業継続が困難となって倒産する（または事業を停止する）ことを指す、調査会社の分類です。主なパターンは次の3つです。
segments.tr: A labor shortage bankruptcy is a classification by research companies referring to bankruptcies (or suspensions of business) due to difficulties in continuing operations caused by employee resignations, recruitment difficulties, or the absence of a successor. The main patterns are the following three:

segments.src: - **求人難型**：募集しても応募が集まらず、受注をこなせない
segments.tr: - **Recruitment difficulty type**: Applications do not gather despite recruitment, and orders cannot be fulfilled

segments.src: - **離職型**：中核人材や現場の担い手が辞め、業務が回らなくなる
segments.tr: - **Resignation type**: Core talent and on-site workers quit, making operations unmanageable

segments.src: - **後継者難型**：経営者の高齢化が進む一方で、事業を引き継ぐ人がいない
segments.tr: - **Successor difficulty type**: Management aging progresses while there is no one to take over the business

segments.src: なお、後継者不足による「廃業」は倒産統計には含まれないため、実際に事業を畳む企業の数は、倒産件数より大きいと考えられます。
segments.tr: Note that "closures" due to a lack of successors are not included in bankruptcy statistics, so the actual number of companies folding their businesses is considered larger than the number of bankruptcies.

segments.src: ## 背景にある5つの構造要因
segments.tr: ## Five Structural Factors Behind the Scene

segments.src: ### 1. 生産年齢人口の減少
segments.tr: ### 1. Decline in the Working-Age Population

segments.src: 日本の生産年齢人口（15〜64歳）は1990年代半ばをピークに減少が続いています。新規に働き手を確保すること自体が、構造的に難しくなっています。
segments.tr: Japan's working-age population (ages 15-64) has continued to decline since peaking in the mid-1990s. Securing new workers itself has structurally become difficult.

segments.src: ### 2. 賃上げ競争と人件費の上昇
segments.tr: ### 2. Wage Increase Competition and Rising Labor Costs

segments.src: 大企業を中心に賃上げが進むなか、中小企業は同じ水準の待遇を提示しにくく、人材が流出しやすい状況があります。最低賃金の引き上げも、収益の薄い事業者には負担となります。
segments.tr: Amid advancing wage increases centered on large corporations, small and medium-sized enterprises find it difficult to offer the same level of treatment, creating a situation where talent easily flows out. Minimum wage hikes also pose a burden for businesses with thin profits.

segments.src: ### 3. 経営者の高齢化と後継者不足
segments.tr: ### 3. Aging Management and Successor Shortages

segments.src: 中小企業の経営者の平均年齢は上昇傾向にあり、数年内に引退時期を迎える経営者が多数います。業績が良好でも承継先が見つからず、「黒字廃業」を選ぶ例が各種調査で指摘されています。
segments.tr: The average age of management in small and medium-sized enterprises is on the rise, with many executives reaching retirement age within a few years. Even with good performance, successors are not found, and various surveys point out examples of choosing "profitable closures."

segments.src: ### 4. 「2024年問題」など働き方改革の影響
segments.tr: ### 4. Impact of Work Style Reforms such as the "2024 Problem"

segments.src: 時間外労働の上限規制が建設・運輸などにも適用され、従来の長時間労働に頼った運営モデルが成り立ちにくくなりました。
segments.tr: Upper limits on overtime work have been applied to construction and transportation, making operational models reliant on conventional long working hours difficult to sustain.

segments.src: ### 5. 原材料・エネルギー高との二重苦
segments.tr: ### 5. Double Hardship with Rising Raw Materials and Energy

segments.src: 人件費に加え、仕入れや燃料費の上昇も重なり、価格転嫁が十分にできない事業者ほど余力を失いやすくなっています。
segments.tr: In addition to labor costs, rising procurement and fuel costs overlap, making businesses unable to sufficiently pass on prices more likely to lose their financial leeway.

segments.src: ## 業種別に見るリスク
segments.tr: ## Risks by Industry

segments.src: ### 建設業
segments.tr: ### Construction Industry

segments.src: - 技能労働者の高齢化が進み、若手の入職が十分ではありません。
segments.tr: - The aging of skilled workers is progressing, and the entry of young workers is insufficient.

segments.src: - 工期や安全管理の要請が厳しく、人員が欠けると受注を断らざるを得ません。
segments.tr: - Requests for construction periods and safety management are strict, and lacking personnel forces the rejection of orders.

segments.src: - 資材高騰による採算悪化も重なります。
segments.tr: - Profitability deterioration due to soaring material costs also overlaps.

segments.src: - **リスクの要点**：受注残があっても施工できず、資金繰りが悪化する。
segments.tr: - **Key Risk Point**: Construction cannot be performed even with backlogs of orders, deteriorating cash flow.

segments.src: ### 物流・運送業
segments.tr: ### Logistics and Transportation Industry

segments.src: - 時間外労働の上限規制により、ドライバー1人あたりの稼働が制限されました。
segments.tr: - Overtime work caps have restricted operations per driver.

segments.src: - 運賃への価格転嫁が進まない事業者は、賃上げの原資を確保しにくい状況です。
segments.tr: - Businesses unable to pass on costs to freight rates find it difficult to secure resources for wage hikes.

segments.src: - 燃料費の変動が収益を圧迫します。
segments.tr: - Fluctuations in fuel costs pressure earnings.

segments.src: - **リスクの要点**：荷物はあっても運べず、車両が稼働できない。
segments.tr: - **Key Risk Point**: Cargo exists but cannot be transported, and vehicles cannot operate.

segments.src: ### 飲食業
segments.tr: ### Food and Beverage Industry

segments.src: - パート・アルバイトへの依存度が高く、人員確保が営業時間に直結します。
segments.tr: - High dependence on part-time and temporary workers makes securing personnel directly tied to operating hours.

segments.src: - 人手が足りず、営業時間の短縮や店舗の閉鎖に至る例があります。
segments.tr: - Staff shortages lead to shortened business hours and store closures in some cases.

segments.src: - 食材・光熱費の上昇で、利益率が低下しています。
segments.tr: - Rising ingredient and utility costs have lowered profit margins.

segments.src: - **リスクの要点**：需要が戻っても、運営体制が追いつかない。
segments.tr: - **Key Risk Point**: Operational systems cannot keep up even if demand returns.

segments.src: ### 介護・福祉
segments.tr: ### Nursing Care and Welfare

segments.src: - 有効求人倍率が全産業平均を大きく上回る状態が続いています。
segments.tr: - Active job openings-to-applicants ratios continue to significantly exceed the all-industry average.

segments.src: - 公定価格（介護報酬）が収入の大半を占めるため、価格転嫁による対応が難しい構造です。
segments.tr: - Because official prices (nursing care fees) account for the majority of revenue, responding through price pass-through is structurally difficult.

segments.src: - 人員配置基準を満たせないと、サービス提供そのものが制約されます。
segments.tr: - Failing to meet staffing standards restricts service provision itself.

segments.src: - **リスクの要点**：利用者のニーズは増える一方、受け入れる体制を維持できない。
segments.tr: - **Key Risk Point**: While user needs continue to increase, systems to accept them cannot be maintained.

segments.src: ### 製造業・小売業など
segments.tr: ### Manufacturing, Retail, and Others

segments.src: - 熟練技能者の退職で技術継承が途切れる例があります。
segments.tr: - Retirement of skilled workers breaks skill transmission in some cases.

segments.src: - 小規模な事業所ほど、特定の従業員への依存度が高くなります。
segments.tr: - Smaller establishments have higher dependence on specific employees.

segments.src: ## 地域経済と雇用への影響
segments.tr: ## Impact on Regional Economy and Employment

segments.src: 事業所が減ると、影響は当事者だけにとどまりません。
segments.tr: When establishments decrease, the impact does not stop at those directly involved.

segments.src: 1. **雇用の喪失**：従業員が職を失うだけでなく、地域内に代わりの雇用先が少ない場合、人口流出につながります。
segments.tr: 1. **Loss of Employment**: Not only do employees lose their jobs, but if there are few alternative employers within the region, it leads to population outflow.

segments.src: 2. **取引先への波及**：下請け・仕入先・協力会社の売上が減り、連鎖的に経営が悪化する恐れがあります。
segments.tr: 2. **Spillover to Business Partners**: Sales of subcontractors, suppliers, and partner companies decrease, risking a chain deterioration of management.

segments.src: 3. **生活インフラの縮小**：介護事業所や運送、地域の飲食店などが減ると、住民の暮らしやすさが低下します。
segments.tr: 3. **Reduction of Living Infrastructure**: Decreases in nursing care providers, transport, and local restaurants lower the livability for residents.

segments.src: 4. **技術・ノウハウの喪失**：地域に根づいた技能や取引関係が失われ、再構築には長い時間がかかります。
segments.tr: 4. **Loss of Skills and Know-how**: Region-rooted skills and trading relationships are lost, and reconstruction takes a long time.

segments.src: 特に過疎化が進む地域では、1社の撤退が地域経済に与える影響が相対的に大きくなります。
segments.tr: Particularly in depopulating regions, the impact of a single company's withdrawal on the regional economy becomes relatively larger.

segments.src: ## 企業・個人にできる備え
segments.tr: ## Preparations Businesses and Individuals Can Make

segments.src: ### 事業者の視点
segments.tr: ### Business Perspective

segments.src: - **業務の見直し・省力化**：ITツールや機械化、業務の標準化で、少人数でも回る体制づくりを進める。
segments.tr: - **Review and Labor-Saving of Operations**: Promote the establishment of a system operable by a small number of people through IT tools, mechanization, and operation standardization.

segments.src: - **待遇と働き方の改善**：賃金だけでなく、休日・柔軟な勤務形態など総合的に見直す。
segments.tr: - **Improvement of Treatment and Work Styles**: Comprehensively review not only wages but also holidays and flexible work formats.

segments.src: - **多様な人材の活用**：女性、シニア、外国人材、副業人材などの受け入れ体制を整える。
segments.tr: - **Utilization of Diverse Human Resources**: Prepare acceptance systems for women, seniors, foreign talent, side-job talent, and others.

segments.src: - **事業承継の早期着手**：親族内承継、従業員承継、M&Aなど複数の選択肢を早めに検討し、事業承継・引継ぎ支援センターなどの公的窓口も活用する。
segments.tr: - **Early Initiation of Business Succession**: Consider multiple options early such as intra-family succession, employee succession, and M&A, while also utilizing public windows like Business Succession and Takeover Support Centers.

segments.src: - **適正な価格転嫁**：取引先との協議を通じ、人件費上昇分を価格に反映する努力を続ける。
segments.tr: - **Appropriate Price Pass-Through**: Continue efforts to reflect labor cost increases in prices through consultations with business partners.

segments.src: ### 働く人・取引先・地域の視点
segments.tr: ### Perspective of Workers, Business Partners, and Regions

segments.src: - 取引先の経営状況に関する情報に目を配り、特定の1社への依存度を下げておく。
segments.tr: - Keep an eye on information regarding the business conditions of partners and lower dependence on a single company.

segments.src: - 地域の事業者の動向を知り、必要な支援制度や相談窓口の情報を共有する。
segments.tr: - Understand the trends of regional businesses and share information on necessary support systems and consultation counters.

segments.src: ## まとめ
segments.tr: ## Conclusion

segments.src: 「黒字でも続けられない」という状況は、一時的な景気の波ではなく、人口構造の変化と労働市場の変化に根ざした課題です。建設・物流・飲食・介護といった人への依存度が高い業種ほど影響を受けやすく、地域の雇用や生活基盤にも波及します。
segments.tr: The situation where one "cannot continue even while profitable" is not a temporary economic wave, but a challenge rooted in changes to population structure and the labor market. Industries with high dependence on people—such as construction, logistics, food service, and nursing care—are easily affected, spilling over into regional employment and living foundations.

segments.src: 省力化、待遇改善、価格転嫁、そして早めの事業承継の準備が、今後の事業継続の鍵になります。最新の統計や支援制度については、各調査機関や中小企業庁、商工会議所などの公表情報をあわせてご確認ください。
segments.tr: Labor-saving, treatment improvement, price pass-through, and early preparation for business succession will be the keys to future business continuity. For the latest statistics and support systems, please check public information from research institutions, the Small and Medium Enterprise Agency, chambers of commerce, and others together.
